title: Update to External Distributor Rebate Program
raw_text:
Update to External Distributor Rebate Program
Category: Market Data and Connectivity; Alert 2026-022
Overview On September 1, 2026, IEX Exchange launched a new rebate program for Market Data Distributors. As described below, pending effectiveness of an SEC rule filing, IEX is expanding the program to apply to Extranet Providers who enlist new Data Subscribers in the same way the program applies to Data Subscribers. External Distributor Rebate Program As described in Trading Alert 2026-12 , IEX Exchange launched an External Distributor Rebate Program on September 1, 2026. Under the program, a Data Subscriber can earn a rebate equal to 75% of the subscription fees a new External Data Subscriber pays IEX for Real-Time IEX market data products (TOPS, DEEP, and DEEP+) it subscribes to through that Data Subscriber. IEX has expanded the External Distributor Rebate Program to also apply to Extranet Providers who enlist new Data Subscribers to subscribe to Real-Time IEX market data products. To qualify, an Extranet Provider must: opt into the program via an updated Extranet Addendum to the Connectivity Services Agreement; report to IEX each month any new Data Subscribers that began subscribing through it during the prior month; and ensure that each new Data Subscriber executes the IEX Data Subscriber Agreement. Only Data Subscribers who were not entitled to receive Real-Time IEX market data products as of July 1, 2026 count toward the rebate; it does not apply to an Extranet Provider’s existing customers. The rebate expires on the earlier of (a) the termination of the External Data Subscriber’s or Data Subscriber’s subscription or (b) August 31, 2028. Additional Resources Rule Filing: SR-IEX-2026-29 IEX Connectivity Services Agreement and Forms (including Extranet Addendum) IEX Market Data Policies More Information Please contact IEX Market Operations or IEX Market Data Team with any questions: Market Operations: marketops@iextrading.com IEX Market Data Team: marketdataops@iextrading.com About IEX Exchange Investors' Exchange LLC (IEX Exchange) is a national securities exchange designed to provide superior execution quality and set a new standard for trading. Since launching in 2016, the exchange has grown to be one of the largest exchange operators globally, by notional value traded. To learn more about IEX Exchange visit iex.io .
